auth_details: No authentication required. Public endpoints accept unauthenticated GET requests; optional JSON via Accept header or query param.
free_tier_limits: unlimited free public use (no published quota); no paid plans
example_response_snippet: {"text":"42 is the answer to the Ultimate Question of Life, the Universe, and Everything.","number":42,"found":true,"type":"trivia"}
description: A free, no-authentication HTTP API that returns interesting trivia, mathematical properties, historical dates, and year facts for any integer. Long-running staple of developer demos and educational apps; supports plain text and JSON responses with optional fragments and default fallbacks when no fact is known.
